sentences.en: Do one single task at a time with full concentration.
sentences.zh: 一次只专注于完成一项任务。

sentences.en: Under Bouteflika, the concentration of power led to abusive power.
sentences.zh: 在布特弗利卡统治下，权力集中导致了滥用权力。

sentences.en: This prison is not a prison but a concentration camp.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一座监狱，而是一个集中营。
